zh.title: 大韓航空開辦首爾仁川（ICN）至墨爾本（MEL）季節性航線
zh.summary: 大韓航空將於2026年12月開辦首爾仁川至墨爾本季節性航線，每週營運三班。
body: 大韓航空宣布，將於2026年12月18日至2027年3月14日期間，開辦韓國首爾仁川國際機場（ICN）直飛澳洲墨爾本機場（MEL）的季節性客運航線，每週營運三班。
該航線將採用波音787-9型客機，於每週三、週五及週日營運。去程航班KE409將於當地時間08:00自首爾仁川起飛，20:30抵達墨爾本；回程航班KE410則於當地時間22:00自墨爾本起飛，次日07:35返抵首爾仁川。
業者表示，新航線的開闢主要受南韓與澳洲之間持續增長的旅遊需求推動，並將配合大韓航空現有的悉尼及布里斯本常規航線，擴大兩地之間的文化、商業與旅遊交流。

en.title: Korean Air to Launch Seasonal Seoul Incheon-Melbourne Route in December 2026
en.summary: Korean Air will launch seasonal flights between Seoul Incheon and Melbourne starting December 2026.
body: Korean Air has announced the launch of seasonal non-stop flights connecting Seoul Incheon International Airport (ICN) and Melbourne Airport (MEL). The service will operate three times weekly from December 18, 2026, through March 14, 2027.

The seasonal route will be operated using Boeing 787-9 aircraft with flights scheduled every Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday. Outbound flight KE409 is scheduled to depart Seoul Incheon at 0800 local time and arrive in Melbourne at 2030 local time. Return flight KE410 will depart Melbourne at 2200 local time and arrive in Seoul Incheon at 0735 local time the following morning.

According to the airline, the route responds to growing travel demand between South Korea and Australia, complementing its existing service to Sydney and Brisbane to support increased business, cultural, and leisure travel.

zh.title: 澳洲Alliance Airlines任命Greenway出任新執行長
zh.summary: 澳洲Alliance Airlines任命Greenway為新任執行長
body: 澳洲Alliance Airlines宣布，任命高階主管Steven Greenway出任新任執行長，將於2026年10月1日正式履新。Greenway將接替服務超過11年的現任執行長Stewart Tully，而Tully將留任至10月29日以協助管理層過渡。
Alliance Airlines為澳洲客製化包機與濕租（ACMI）服務營運商，旗下擁有超過70架飛機。新任執行長Steven Greenway具備逾25年航空業經驗，先前曾擔任沙烏地阿拉伯flyadeal執行長，並曾在WestJet與酷航（Scoot）等航空公司擔任高階管理職務。

en.title: Alliance Airlines Names Steven Greenway as New CEO Effective October 1
en.summary: Alliance Airlines appoints Steven Greenway as new chief executive officer effective October 1, 2026.
body: Australian carrier Alliance Airlines has appointed aviation industry veteran Steven Greenway as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Greenway succeeds Stewart Tully, who is stepping down after more than 11 years as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director. Tully will remain with the airline through October 29, 2026, to assist with the leadership transition.

Alliance Airlines, operated under Alliance Aviation Services Limited, provides ACMI, contract, and charter airline services in Australia with a fleet of more than 70 aircraft. Greenway brings over 25 years of international aviation leadership experience to the role, having most recently served as CEO of Saudi low-cost carrier flyadeal and previously holding executive positions at WestJet and Scoot.
